saw_lines: Donors give to a cause when one animal or place feels personal, then give again after seeing proof it worked.
So the gift is won or lost in the opening line, before a reader reaches the donate button.
Your 30 ads carry no proof number, so donors have nothing concrete before they give. Collect one real count, like supporters or rescued areas, and lead the next batch with it.

points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new donor has nothing concrete to trust before giving. Collect one real count, like supporters or rescued areas, and open the next batch with it.
None of your 30 ads carry an offer, so a first-time supporter has no reason to act today. Test a matched first gift or a named animal adoption bundle, printed in line one of three new ads.

Your 30 ads open with 12 different stories, and the biggest repeats in 7 of them, so one opener is overused. Keep the wildlife finder and the Aarau river walk, and make the next batch of three from those two openers.

4 ads have run 60+ days, so the account already has winners. Your oldest, the tree story from 14 Sep 2026, is still live. Build three variations with new opening lines and the same donate button, run beside it.
